---

name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or improvement for the project
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
-------------------

## Feature Description

Please provide a clear and concise description of the feature or improvement you would like to see.

## Problem or Motivation

Describe the problem this feature would solve or explain why this improvement would be useful.

## Proposed Solution

Explain how you would like the feature to work. Include any relevant details about the expected behavior or user experience.

## Benefits

Describe how this feature would improve the project, user experience, performance, accessibility, or maintainability.

## Alternatives Considered

Describe any alternative solutions, approaches, or workarounds you have considered.

## Additional Context

Add any additional information that may help us understand the proposal, such as:

* Screenshots
* UI mockups
* Design references
* Example implementations
* Related issues or discussions

## Checklist

Before submitting the feature request, please confirm:

* [ ] I have searched existing issues to make sure this feature has not already been requested.
* [ ] I have clearly explained the problem or motivation.
* [ ] I have described the proposed solution.
* [ ] I have provided relevant context or references where applicable.
